reconcile.note: Fausset and his co-authors treat Christ alone as the true foundation of 1 Corinthians 3:11, calling apostles and prophets foundations only in a secondary sense.

sides.snippet: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.
sides.verseText: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

sides.snippet: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone
sides.verseText: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;
